meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 它会用 DuckDB、Polars、numpy 直接读取 CSV、Parquet、JSON,做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列和清洗,需要时用 matplotlib 画图,全程不使用 pandas。较重的计算会报告行数和耗时,不额外加图表或探索。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件,或做分组、连接、聚合等数据处理与绘图时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 DuckDB 查这个 CSV,按城市分组统计订单总额
say.note: 会先探测文件大小和可用内存再定引擎

say.text: 把 data.parquet 加载进内存,我后面要反复查询
say.note: 一次扫描后重复查询即毫秒级

say.text: 给这份销售数据画一张趋势图
say.note: 按 visualization.md 出图并做视觉检查

howto.what_en: It reads CSV, Parquet and JSON with DuckDB, Polars and numpy for group-by, joins, aggregation, time series and cleaning, charts with matplotlib, and never uses pandas. Heavy work gets row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet or JSON data, or to do group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning or plotting.

say_en.text: Query this CSV with DuckDB and group order totals by city
say_en.note: Probes file size and RAM first

say_en.text: Load data.parquet into memory; I'll run repeated queries
say_en.note: One scan, then fast repeat queries

say_en.text: Chart the sales trend from this data
